description: A woman in a black and gold embroidered veil and dress stands at left, gesturing, with attendants holding torches beside her at night. Behind her, a red sandstone and white marble domed-arch mausoleum is under construction, with scaffolding, ladders, workers carrying bricks and blocks, and small fires burning on the upper walls. A brick dome is partly built at the top right. No visible text, border or frame.
